positive_snippets:
location, cleanliness, comfortable rooms (bed, space), friendly/helpful staff, great amenities (food, spa, Wi-Fi), and overall value, mentioning specific positive experiences like a seamless late check-in or delicious breakfast to show you're a real guest. Focus on what made your stay special, whether it's the quiet hallways for rest or the mountain views from the balcony, to help future travelers.
Key Elements to Mention
Location: Central, convenient, quiet, near attractions.
Cleanliness: Spotless rooms, fresh sheets, tidy bathrooms.
Staff/Service: Friendly, attentive, helpful, welcoming, quick check-in/out.
Room Comfort: Comfortable bed, good space, decor, blackout curtains, amenities (boiler, safe).
Amenities: Delicious breakfast, good food, spa, reliable Wi-Fi

clean, comfortable rooms with great sleep quality, friendly & helpful staff, excellent location for connectivity/shopping, good food, and value for money, though sometimes Wi-Fi or specific amenities can vary. To find one, look for high guest ratings (9.0+) on sites like Booking.com, check reviews for specifics on service (staff names mentioned), cleanliness, and address potential issues like slow Wi-Fi or noisy rooms.
Key Qualities of Good Hotel Reviews:
Staff: Friendly, polite, helpful, attentive.
Rooms: Clean, comfortable, spacious, good sleep quality.
Location: Convenient, central, close to attractions/transport.
Food: Great breakfast, delicious options.
Value: Worth the price.
Atmosphere: Stylish, beautiful surroundings.
Tips for Choosing a Hotel:
Check Ratings: Look for scores above 9.0 on review sites.
Read Specifics: Focus on recent reviews mentioning staff names, food, or cleanliness.
Note Cons: Be aware of common complaints like slow Wi-Fi or noise, and see if the hotel addresses them.
Consider Location: Decide if you need a central spot or a quieter area.
Example Hotel Review Snippets:
"Staff is kind and helpful. The rooms are nicely done and very comfortable to stay in. The sleep quality was excellent." (Hotel Marina, Shimla).
"Best location in terms of easy connectivity, food, market place and metro station. staff is good, rooms r spacious and tidy." (Hotel Good Times, Delhi).
"Excellent stay, service and facilities are superb... staff are kind... Clean and comfortable." (The Imperial, New Delhi).
